proposed_fix_matrix.title: Ownership provenance is a session-scoped state machine
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Record external/pre-existing, app-started, unknown and direct-child states separately. Claim readsb ownership only after an observed-inactive preflight, successful explicit app Start and stable-active verification; unknown/error states must not be interpreted as permission to stop external hardware.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: Pre-existing ON and unknown state cannot be claimed or passively stopped; app-owned begins only after successful verified Start.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Exit must not stop external readsb or tar1090
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Retain current saved release_sdr_on_exit preference but scope exit auto-release to provably app-owned readsb only; always preserve externally owned readsb and tar1090. App-owned direct child always released as before. Main ON default retains intent, while an explicit OFF retains user's chosen persistence until owner separately approves a change.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: ON + external => no privileged action; ON + app-owned => only readsb stop; OFF => no systemd auto-stop; direct child always stopped.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Exit-only readsb command needs exact least-privilege policy
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: For future explicitly authorized code+installer review, use exact single-service sudo argv (never generic shell, killall or broad sudo) for ownership-qualified readsb release. Existing canonical sudoers authorizes paired readsb+tar1090 only; separately plan policy migration/rollback and fail safely on old installations.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: No sudo success assumed without policy; denial leaves clear user-visible warning and retry; no tar1090 process is stopped.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Explicit Stop/Restart distinct from passive Exit
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Preserve existing user-invoked paired Stop/Restart contract pending explicit product decision, with clear warning it can stop pre-existing readsb+tar1090. Passive Exit MUST NOT invoke paired service_action('stop'). Reconcile Restart attribution following Stop/Start; no automatic ownership of externally restarted unrelated services.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: Explicit Stop paired; no Exit paired; external Restart requires confirmation and ownership ledger correct after success/failure.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Start no-op on active externally managed readsb
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: When pre-existing readsb is active, the app should observe it without issuing paired systemctl start. Preserve non-owning status and avoid unnecessarily restarting or touching external tar1090. Only an explicit user Start from confirmed inactive may acquire ownership.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: No sudo command and owner=false on pre-existing services; no false owned state on start failure.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Handle partial start, timeout and verification failure
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Separate attempted command, stable service state and owned provenance. Simulate service start succeeds but _verify_transition raises, sudo nonzero, concurrent external start, unknown is-active and post-start crash; report ambiguous partial ownership without silently killing external services or falsely indicating device released.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: No false success, no accidental external stop, persisted actionable error and deterministic recovery path.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Qt constructor and multiwindow lifecycle ABI preservation
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Preserve current RadarWindow(controller=None, owns_receiver=True) and native embedded classic non-owner. Only owning primary window releases controller. Do NOT transplant old PR #7 RadarWindow constructor or remove shared map/bridge features.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: Closing secondary window never kills shared readsb; primary close uses one release operation; no Qt TypeError.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Serialized Start/Stop/Restart/Close + clear failure UI
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Coordinate classic action_future and native _startup_future/receiver_lock before passive release, prevent start-after-close, do not close and destroy map/UI before release status is known; on qualified owned-stop failure cancel/retry close without claiming SDR available. Bounded wait must not freeze UI indefinitely.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: No background start after application closes; map server remains valid if close cancelled; failure remains user visible.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Do not lose ownership when changing receiver mode
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Before switching from locally app-owned Linux services into Remote JSON / Direct mode, require explicit stop/handoff or keep a mode-independent owned-service cleanup record. Existing configure can change mode while owner flag stays true; current close tests only current mode.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: No orphaned app-started service after mode switch; Remote JSON never manages unrelated services.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Preserve explicit saved opt-out and EN/TR/DE communication
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Retain release_sdr_on_exit key and EN-default label; future locale coverage EN/TR/DE must explain app-owned versus external, map viewer independence, explicit Stop impact and denied sudo. Do not conflate boot enable/disable with active receiver ownership.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: Saved OFF persists across restart, default ON preserved, localized warnings have equivalent safety meaning.

proposed_fix_matrix.title: Keep Direct and Remote mode guards and ownership separate
proposed_fix_matrix.proposal: Direct readsb child belongs to app and must exit via terminate/wait/kill scoped to its own PID/temp data; Remote JSON Start/Stop are forbidden and exit must do no local sudo; no hardware release claim from mocked process exit.
proposed_fix_matrix.acceptance: Fake child stop and remote no-side-effects, plus separate later authorized physical SDR claim/release test.
